Section 5(a) of Republic Act No. 6713 (Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees) provides that all requests for public documents or action must be acted upon within fifteen (15) working days from receipt, unless otherwise provided by law or regulation. The inaction of the concemed office beyond said period may constitute a violation of this statutory duty. In view of the foregoing, and consistent with DILG Opinion No. 117, s. 2022, it position that you are not legally required to procure a clearance from the LGU as an ouwng LCE, and that the absence of such clearance should not hinder tie release of your salary or tie performance of your duties as Representative.
